Create a spooky and mysterious atmosphere with this White Spider Web, perfect for adding a creepy touch to your Halloween setup. Designed to resemble realistic cobwebs, it can be stretched and arranged across walls, ceilings, doors, windows, furniture, tables and other spaces to create an instant haunted-house effect.

Product Details
  • Accessories not included
  • Dimensions/Size: 200cm (L) x 150cm (W) 
  • Colour: White and black
Features
  • Spider web design
Additional Information
  • Care instructions: Clean according to given instructions

Create an effortlessly casual vibe with the Short Sleeve Oversized Boyfriend T-shirt, featuring a roomy fit that?s easy to wear all day. The simple design makes it a go-to piece for styling with your favourite basics.

Material
  • Cotton
  • Single jersey fabric
Features
  • Drop shoulder design
  • Heavyweight fabric
  • Ribbed crew neck
  • Short sleeves
Fit and Model Size
  • Oversized fit
  • Model is 179cm tall and wears a Size 12
Care Instructions
  • Warm machine wash with similar colours
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Warm iron on reverse side if required
  • Do not dry-clean

*Each sold separately

Make Halloween even more fun with this Trick or Treat Pail. Its themed design is perfect for collecting sweets and treats during spooky celebrations.

Product Details

  • Includes only 1 Trick or Treat Pail
  • Dimensions/Size: 18cm (H) x 23cm (Dia.)

Features

  • Printed
  • Reusable and hand washable

Additional Information

  • Note:This product is not a toy.

Disclaimer: Products are sold separately and come in various designs. We cannot guarantee which design you will receive as products are selected at random for online orders.

Keep favourite nibbles fresh and ready with this 2 Pack Stainless Steel Snack Box set, perfect for portioning snacks for busy days. Lightweight yet sturdy, these handy boxes make packing fruit, nuts and treats simple wherever the day takes you.

Product Details
  • 2 pack
  • Capacity: 210ml
  • Dimensions/Size: 15.9cm (H) x 7.4cm (W) x 3.7cm (D)
  • Material:
    • Body: 304 Stainless steel
    • Lid: Silicone
  • Colour: Brown 
Features
  • 2 separate compartments
  • BPA free
  • Dishwasher safe (top shelf only)
  • Freezer safe
Additional Information
  • Care instructions: Clean according to given instructions
  • Note: Not suitable for microwave

*Each sold separately

Set the scene for a spooky Halloween with this Caution Tape! Perfect for decorating doors, walls, windows, parties and haunted houses, it adds an eerie crime-scene effect. Use it to create boundaries or transform any space into a creepy setup.

Product Details
  • Includes only 1 Caution Tape
  • Dimensions/Size: 300cm (L) 
Features
  • Halloween themed
Additional Information
  • Note: This is not a toy. For decoration only.
Disclaimer: Products are sold separately and come in various designs. We cannot guarantee which design you will receive as products are selected at random for online orders.

Add a charming touch to your Christmas decor with this Light Up Ceramic Gingerbread House. Featuring a classic gingerbread house design with illuminating details, it is ideal for shelves, mantels, tables and festive displays.

Product Details
  • Dimensions/Size: 20cm (H) x 18.5cm (W) x 8.5cm (D)
  • Material: Ceramic
  • Battery information: Requires 2 x 1.5V AA batteries (not included)
  • Colour / No. of lights: Warm white LED bulbs (non-replaceable)
  • Colour: Brown (Gingerbread house)
Features
  • Gingerbread house design
  • Battery operated
Additional Information
  • Suitable for indoor use only
  • Usage instructions given on packaging. Please follow instructions carefully
  • Note:
    • Battery installation by an adult is required.
    • For decoration only. This is not a toy.
Warning: Keep away from children and pets.

Little ones can blow as many bubbles as they want and have a great time popping them with this 2 Litre Bubble Premium Bubble Solution.

Product Details
  • Suitable for ages: 3+ years
  • Net volume: 2 litres
  • Dimensions/Size: 30cm (H) x 10cm (W) x 8cm (D)
  • Product weight: 2.07kg
Additional Information
  • Adult supervision required
  • Recommended for outdoor use only
  • Note: Don't drink the bubble solution. Not intended for human consumption. 
Caution: Direct contact with clothing/fabrics may cause staining. Launder as per care instructions on garment as soon as possible.

Warning: Choking hazard. Small parts. Follow usage instructions carefully.

Wrap your gifts in festive cheer with this Santa-themed Christmas Wrapping Paper. Featuring a joyful holiday design and vibrant colours, it adds a magical touch to every present under the tree.

Product Details
  • Dimensions/Size: 700cm (L) x 70cm (W)
  • Material: Paper
Features
  • Santa design
  • Grid lined
Additional Information

Note: Pull down the full length of the wrap to open. Extra paper added to allows for opening.

Material
  • Cotton
  • Single jersey, knit and ribbed fabric
Features
  • Ribbed crew neck
  • Short sleeves
Fit and Model Size
  • Regular fit
  • The model featured is wearing a Size 12
Care Instructions
  • Warm machine wash with similar colours
  • Do not bleach
  • Do not tumble dry
  • Warm iron on reverse side if required
  • Do not dry-clean

This Print T-shirt is a versatile wardrobe essential for little ones. Soft and comfy, it's perfect for everyday wear or adding a simple, stylish touch to any outfit.
